date.description: Date in D.M.YYYY format, for example 24.4.2019.

info.description: Search the Chief Secretary for Administration's My Blog. The publisher does not document an API version; “undocumented” is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. The API documentation specifies English-language results; catalog metadata also lists Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese API resources, but provides no corresponding parameter documentation or response schemas. Authentication requirements are not specified.
info.title: Chief Secretary for Administration - My Blog

get.description: Returns My Blog entries. All times are Hong Kong Time (GMT+8). If both date parameters are omitted, the last six months of entries are returned. A maximum of 400 records will be returned. The documented date range is inclusive.

parameters.description: Language of the requested blog. The English-language API resource is documented at this URL; the catalog also lists Traditional Chinese (tc) and Simplified Chinese (sc) resources, but the publisher API documentation does not define these values or their response contract.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Inclusive start date in YYYYMMDD format, for example 20190102. The earliest accepted date is 16 January 2017. Must be used together with end.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Inclusive end date in YYYYMMDD format, for example 20190109. The latest accepted date is today. Must be used together with start.
parameters.name: end

schema.description: The response envelope is not specified. The documented entry fields are represented as a permissive object.

date.description: Date in D.M.YYYY format, for example 24.4.2019.

200.description: Successful search response. The data dictionary documents the fields of each blog entry but does not specify the top-level JSON response structure.
